title: El-Sayed Fights Trump Villain Tag | Radio Balance of Power: Early Edition 9/8/2026
description:
On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondent Kailey Leinz discusses the latest from the White House. On today's show, Atlantic Council Senior Fellow Melinda Haring, Harvard Kennedy School Ash Center Visiting Democracy Fellow Jeanne Sheehan Zaino, Echo Canyon Consulting Founder Jon Seaton and Michigan Democratic Senate Candidate Abdul El-Sayed.
